title: Starc vs Russell - Mitchell Marsh Post Match Interview | WI vs AUS, 4th T20 - Press Conference
quote_text:
The Mitchells take the West Indies to the sword in St Lucia
The Mitchells - Marsh and Starc - delivered for Australia in a welcome return to top of the class in the CG Insurance T20 International against the West Indies in St Lucia.

Marsh registered his highest T20 score and best bowling figures while Starc reaffirmed his status as one of the best fast bowlers in world cricket with a clutch final over.

Australia held out a fast finishing West Indies to win by four runs after their best performance with the bat so far on the tour.

Captain Aaron Finch returned to his devastating best with 53 from 37 balls including five fours and three sixes. He supported Marsh who was even more attacking with his 75 coming from just 44 balls with six sixes, a similar performance to Chris Gayle in game three.

It was the third time in the Series Marsh recorded his top score in T20 Internationals following his 51 and 54 in games one and two.  His strike rate was 170.4 in tonight’s game. He then took 3-24 with the ball, his best return in the shortest form of the game.

Despite losing two quick wickets in the middle Australia finished the job through Dan Christian with 22 from 14 balls to give the visitors a strong 6-189 at the break.

Again, West Indies spinner Hayden Walsh Junior helped his side limit the damage with 3-27 from his four overs. Australia were in well front for most of the match before two 20-plus overs from Christian in the middle and Riley Meredith at the end kept them in the game.

#WIvAUS #Marsh #Starc
